title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Payment Terms: Due Dates, Late Payment Fees, Courtesy Credits and Suspension
content:
1. **Due date and application of amounts.** Tuition for each billing month of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program is due by the tuition due day of that month. Payments, remittances and credits are applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first.
2. **Late payment fee.** *The former clause is no longer in force: it said that when the amounts applied by the due day leave any part of that month's tuition unpaid, one late payment fee of the product's late payment fee posts the late-fee offset days after the due day, and that a month whose tuition posted after its due day becomes late only at the next month's due day. It is superseded by the current late payment fee basis.*
3. **Courtesy credit.** At the family's request, a late payment fee is credited back as a late fee courtesy waiver. A courtesy credit is granted only while fewer than the yearly courtesy allowance of courtesy credits have been posted on the enrollment in the school year. The school year runs July 1 through June 30, and the one that counts is the one containing the request date. The count is by the date each courtesy credit posted.
4. **Suspension.** *The former clause is no longer in force: it said that when at least the suspension minimum of tuition remains unpaid more than the suspension period after a month's due day, care is suspended, and that tuition continues to post while care is suspended because the seat is held. It is superseded by the current suspension basis.*
5. **Reinstatement.** A suspended enrollment resumes only after its entire past-due balance is paid, as the enrollment's billing history shows.
6. **Nonpayment withdrawal.** An enrollment still suspended the nonpayment withdrawal period after its suspension date is withdrawn, and the balance remains owed.

## Figures by plan

| Figure (same on all six Creek Kids Club plans) | Value |
|---|---|
| Tuition due day | day 10 of the billing month |
| Late payment fee | 15.00 |
| Late-fee offset | 1 calendar day after the due day |
| Courtesy credits per enrollment per school year | 1 |
| Suspension period | 21 calendar days after the due day |
| Suspension minimum past due | 25.00 |
| Nonpayment withdrawal period | 14 calendar days after the suspension date |
| Reinstatement requires the full past-due balance | yes |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- **Courtesy allowance.** An enrollment that has had no courtesy credit this school year may receive one on request. Once that one credit is posted, a further request in the same school year is not granted, because the count is no longer fewer than 1. A request after the next July 1 counts within the new school year.
- **Oldest charge first.** A household owes an unpaid registration fee and then a month's tuition. A payment is applied to the registration fee first, and only the remainder reaches the tuition.
- **Reinstatement.** A payment that clears only part of the past-due balance leaves care suspended.

superseded_clauses: When the amounts applied by the due day leave any part of that month's tuition unpaid, one late payment fee of late_payment_fee posts late_payment_fee_offset_days after the due day; a month whose tuition posted after its due day becomes late only at the next month's due day.

When at least suspension_minimum_past_due of tuition remains unpaid more than suspension_days_past_due days after a month's due day, care is suspended; tuition continues to post while care is suspended, because the seat is held.
